integrity: The claim is derived from the source fixed-point and peak-height formulas. Numerical values were used only for consistency checks; the proof is analytic.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the singular maximum-exit cycle of the toy model; it does not provide uniform finite-\(\varepsilon\) error bounds or extend the asymptotics to the general planar model.
title: Sharp control-contrast laws for the maximal entry-exit cycle
